v. 毁坏；破坏；劫掠
n. 破坏；蹂躏
words.ex: The storm ravaged the small village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了这个小村庄。
words.en: To ravage means to cause severe and extensive damage to something.

words.tr:
n. 嘎嘎叫声；庸医；冒充内行的人
v. 嘎嘎地叫；大声闲谈；冒充内行
words.ex: The duck made a loud quack.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子发出了响亮的嘎嘎叫声。
words.en: A quack is someone who pretends to have medical skills that they do not really possess. It can also refer to the sound a duck makes.

words.tr: v. 重新分配；再分配；重分配；
words.ex: The government will redistribute the money to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府将把钱重新分配给贫困家庭。
words.en: To redistribute something means to distribute it in a different way, so that it is shared more fairly or equally.

words.ex: The storm was formidable and destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴很可怕，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.ex: He is hypocritical when he says he hates lying but lies all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他说他讨厌撒谎，却总是撒谎，这很虚伪。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being hypocritical, you mean that they pretend to have qualities, beliefs, or feelings that they do not really have.

words.ex: The children danced gaily at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上欢快地跳舞。
words.en: In a cheerful and light-hearted manner.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.tr: adj. 不证自明的；不言而喻的
words.ex: It is self-evident that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度沸腾是显而易见的。
words.en: Something that is self-evident is so obvious that there is no need for proof or explanation.

words.tr: adj. 耸人听闻的；极好的；
words.ex: The newspaper published a sensational story about a ghost.
words.ex_cn: 这家报纸刊登了一篇关于幽灵的耸人听闻的消息。
words.en: A sensational event or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The magic trick astounded the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们惊呆了。
words.en: If something astounds you, it surprises or shocks you very much.

words.ex: The two companies will amalgamate next month.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司下个月将合并。
words.en: If two or more organizations amalgamate, they join together and become one organization.

words.tr: adj. 难以达到的；无法接近的；
words.ex: The mountain peak is inaccessible in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这座山峰在冬天难以到达。
words.en: If a place is inaccessible, it is very difficult or impossible to reach or enter.

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.tr: adj. 羞辱性的；丢脸的； v. “humiliate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The humiliating comment made him feel small.
words.ex_cn: 那句羞辱性的话让他感到自己很渺小。
words.en: If something is humiliating, it makes you feel ashamed and stupid, often because it involves a loss of respect or dignity in front of other people.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: The inclusion of all students is important.
words.ex_cn: 包含所有学生是很重要的。
words.en: The act of including or the state of being included.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.tr: n. （新法律或体系的）实施；不合理要求；麻烦
words.ex: The tax imposition made life harder for poor families.
words.ex_cn: 征税让贫困家庭的生活更加艰难。
words.en: The act of imposing something, such as a tax, duty, or law, especially in a way that is considered to be unfair or burdensome.

words.tr:
v. 落下；
adj. 点亮的；
words.ex: The bird alighted on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟落在了树上。
words.en: If someone alights from a vehicle or if they alight, they get out of it after a journey.

words.ex: The astrologer told her fortune with stars.
words.ex_cn: 占星家用星星为她算命。
words.en: An astrologer is a person who studies the movements and positions of the stars and planets in the belief that they influence human affairs and natural phenomena.

words.tr: v. 系上；附加；使相关；使依附；隶属于；“attach”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附属的；附加的；依恋的；
words.ex: He attached the leash to the dog's collar.
words.ex_cn: 他把狗绳系在狗的项圈上。
words.en: If you say that one thing is attached to another, you mean that the two things are connected, either physically or because they are related in some way.

words.ex: The children stood in awe at the sight of the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到山时感到敬畏。
words.en: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.

words.ex: He felt deep pain from his friend's betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 他因朋友的背叛感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: The action of betraying one's country, a group, or a person; treachery.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.tr:
v. 鼓掌；拍手
n. 鼓掌；拍手
words.ex: The crowd will clap after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众会鼓掌。
words.en: To clap means to strike the palms of your hands together to show appreciation or to make a noise.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.tr: adj. 群体的；社区的；公有的；
words.ex: They share a communal kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们共用一个群体厨房。
words.en: Communal means relating to or shared by all the members of a community.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He didn't study, consequently he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，因此考试不及格。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.ex: He tried to dispel the fear with calm words.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用平静的话语消除恐惧。
words.en: To dispel something such as a fear, belief, or idea means to make it disappear or to make people stop believing it.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.tr: v. 使不合格；剥夺资格
words.ex: He was disqualified for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而被取消资格。
words.en: If someone is disqualified from something, they are officially stopped from doing it, usually because they have done something wrong or broken a rule.

words.ex: He showed distaste for loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对嘈杂的声音感到反感。
words.en: If you feel distaste for someone or something, you dislike them and consider them to be unpleasant, unattractive, or morally unacceptable.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.ex: He studied familial patterns in his research.
words.ex_cn: 他在研究中分析了家族模式。
words.en: Relating to or occurring in a family or its members.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr: n. 治疗；疗癒；愈合； v. “heal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The healing of the wound took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 伤口的治疗花了两周时间。
words.en: The process of becoming healthy again, especially after a cut or other injury, or of making someone healthy again.

words.ex: The horseshoe is nailed to a horse's hoof.
words.ex_cn: 马蹄形铁掌被钉在马的蹄子上。
words.en: A horseshoe is a piece of metal shaped like a U, which is fixed with nails to the bottom of a horse's foot in order to protect it.

words.ex: He values individualism in his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中重视个人主义。
words.en: Individualism is the belief that the rights and freedom of the individual are the most important rights in a society.

words.ex: Countries rely on each other for trade and resources, showing interdependence.
words.ex_cn: 国家之间依靠彼此进行贸易和资源交换，体现了相互依赖。
words.en: A situation in which people or things depend on each other.

words.ex: His refusal to listen is irrational.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝倾听是不合理的。
words.en: If you describe someone's feelings and behavior as irrational, you mean they are not based on logical reasons or clear thinking.

words.tr: v. 连接；联系；“link”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two roads are linked by a bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路通过一座桥连接起来。
words.en: Connected or related to something else.

words.tr: v. 点燃；照亮；“light”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He lit the candle with a match.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了蜡烛。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of 'light', meaning to ignite or to illuminate.

words.ex: The multinational company has offices in five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家跨国公司在五个国家设有办事处。
words.en: A multinational company or business operates in several different countries.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的；神秘主义的
words.ex: The painting had a mystical quality that captivated viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种神秘的特质，令观众着迷。
words.en: If you describe something as mystical, you mean that it has spiritual qualities or that it involves spiritual powers and influences.

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: The black cat is an omen of bad luck.
words.ex_cn: 黑猫是不祥之兆。
words.en: An omen is an event or phenomenon that is believed to foretell the future, often signifying the advent of change.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: We had dinner on the patio.
words.ex_cn: 我们在庭院里吃了晚饭。
words.en: A patio is an outdoor space generally used for dining or recreation that adjoins a residence and is typically paved.

words.ex: The climb was perilous in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 在暴风雨中，这次攀登非常危险。
words.en: Full of danger or risk.

words.tr: adj. 可容许的；可承认的
words.ex: It is permissible to use a calculator in this test.
words.ex_cn: 在这次考试中使用计算器是允许的。
words.en: If something is permissible, it is considered to be acceptable because it does not break any laws or rules.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: There has been slow progression in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学技能有了缓慢的进展。
words.en: The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: adv. 僵硬地；严格地；固执地
words.ex: He follows the rules rigidly.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a strict or inflexible manner.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.tr: n. 迷信；迷信观念（或思想）；
words.ex: He avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迷信而不愿从梯子下走过。
words.en: A superstition is a belief or practice resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: The beach is unspoiled and clean.
words.ex_cn: 这片海滩未被破坏，很干净。
words.en: If you describe a place as unspoiled, you think it is beautiful because it has not been changed or built on for a long time.

words.ex: The box remained untouched on the table.
words.ex_cn: 盒子原封不动地留在桌子上。
words.en: If something is untouched, it has not been changed or affected by something.

words.tr: adj. 未经治疗的；未处理的
words.ex: The water is untreated and unsafe to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这水未经处理，不能喝。
words.en: If something is untreated, it has not been dealt with in any way.

words.ex: The story he told was untrue.
words.ex_cn: 他讲的故事是不真实的。
words.en: If a statement or idea is untrue, it is false and not based on facts.

words.tr: adj. 不能信赖的；不可靠的；
words.ex: He is untrustworthy because he always lies.
words.ex_cn: 他总是撒谎，所以不可信赖。
words.en: If you describe someone as untrustworthy, you think they are not reliable and cannot be trusted.

words.ex: The unused book is still on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 那本未使用过的书还在书架上。
words.en: If something is unused, it is not being used, especially because it is not needed or has not been used before.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴削弱了那座旧桥。
words.en: To weaken something means to reduce its strength, intensity, or effectiveness.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The mouse is gnawing on the wood.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠正在啃木头。
words.en: To gnaw means to bite or chew something persistently, especially something hard, or to cause persistent worry or discomfort.

words.tr: n. 城河；壕坑; n. （Foss）人名；（德、英、法、西、瑞典）福斯
words.ex: The castle is surrounded by a deep foss.
words.ex_cn: 城堡被一条深城河环绕。
words.en: A fossilized remnant or trace of an organism from a past geological age.

words.tr: n. 内部通话系统（或设备）； 对讲机
words.ex: He pressed the intercom to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他按了对讲机来寻求帮助。
words.en: An intercom is a communication system that allows people in different parts of a building or vehicle to speak to each other.

words.tr:
v. 用布包裹；用绷带缠
n. 长而宽的一长条；割刈的带状地
words.ex: She swathed the baby in a soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 她用一条柔软的毯子把婴儿裹起来。
words.en: To wrap or bind in or as if in a bandage or cloth.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: The country increased its armament to protect its borders.
words.ex_cn: 该国增加了军备以保护其边境。
words.en: The weapons and military equipment that a country has, or the process of increasing them.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The stylistic choice of words made the poem more beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 词语的文体选择使这首诗更加优美。
words.en: Relating to the style or manner of something, especially in literature or art.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: The theatrical lighting made the stage look magical.
words.ex_cn: 剧场的灯光让舞台显得神奇。
words.en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre or to the performance of plays. It can also describe behaviour that is exaggerated and intended to attract attention.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.ex: The stony path made walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这条多石的小路让行走变得困难。
words.en: Something that is stony is covered with stones or contains a lot of stones. It can also describe someone who is unfriendly or unemotional.

words.tr: adj. 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的
words.ex: She gave him unconditional love.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他无条件的爱。
words.en: If you describe something as unconditional, you mean that it is not limited or affected by any conditions.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The substitution of sugar with honey made the cake healthier.
words.ex_cn: 用蜂蜜代替糖使蛋糕更健康。
words.en: The act of replacing one person or thing with another.

words.ex: The political turbulence caused many people to leave the country.
words.ex_cn: 政治骚乱导致许多人离开了这个国家。
words.en: A state of conflict or confusion; irregular atmospheric motion especially when characterized by up-and-down currents.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: He felt homesick after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到想家。
words.en: If you are homesick, you feel unhappy because you are away from home and are missing your family, friends, and home very much.

words.tr: adj. 加速的； v. 加速；加快；“accelerate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accelerating car sped down the highway.
words.ex_cn: 加速的汽车在高速公路上飞驰。
words.en: If a process or the rate of something accelerates or if something accelerates it, it gets faster and faster.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The analyst studied the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位分析者仔细研究了数据。
words.en: An analyst is a person whose job is to analyze a subject and give opinions about it.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: They paid five dollars apiece for the tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他们每人五美元买了票。
words.en: If something is given or sold apiece, each person is given or sold one, or each thing is sold for a particular amount.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr: adj. 铁石心肠的；无情的；起老茧的
words.ex: He was callous to his friend's pain.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的痛苦无动于衷。
words.en: A callous person or action is very cruel and shows no concern for other people or their feelings.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He works on flextime to balance his family and job.
words.ex_cn: 他采用弹性工作时间来平衡家庭和工作。
words.en: A system of working a set number of hours with the starting and finishing times chosen within agreed limits by the employee.

words.ex: He was formerly a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他以前是一名老师。
words.en: Previously; in the past.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.ex: They worked harmoniously together.
words.ex_cn: 他们和谐地一起工作。
words.en: In a way that is harmonious, showing a pleasing combination or arrangement of different elements.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: He hurriedly left the room.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开了房间。
words.en: If you do something hurriedly, you do it quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: adj. 天生的；先天的；天赋的
words.ex: He has an inborn talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他天生就有音乐才能。
words.en: An inborn quality or ability is one that you have had naturally since birth.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.tr: n. 雷区；危机四伏的局面
words.ex: Navigating the political landscape can be like walking through a minefield.
words.ex_cn: 在政治领域中航行就像是在雷区中行走。
words.en: A minefield is an area of land or water where explosive mines have been hidden. It can also refer to a situation that is full of hidden dangers or difficulties.

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: The teacher will notify the students about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会通知学生们关于考试的事。
words.en: If you notify someone of something, you officially inform them about it.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: He is a programmer who writes code for apps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名为应用程序编写代码的程序员。
words.en: A programmer is a person who writes computer programs as a profession or hobby.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的现在分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school is providing free lunches to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen only if a particular condition is met.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: v. 绑；系；拴；约束；与...成平局；“tie”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He tied his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系好了鞋带。
words.en: If something is tied, it is fastened or secured with a knot or similar method.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.tr: adj. 不可更改的；无法改变的
words.ex: The laws of physics are unalterable.
words.ex_cn: 物理定律是不可改变的。
words.en: If something is unalterable, it cannot be changed.

words.tr: adj. 不需要的；多余的；无用的；
words.ex: The unwanted clothes were donated to charity.
words.ex_cn: 不需要的衣服被捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: If something is unwanted, it is not wanted or desired.

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: He envisions a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 他想象一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: To envision something is to imagine it as a future possibility; it is often used to describe the act of foreseeing or planning for the future.

words.ex: He inherited his ancestral land from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里继承了祖传的土地。
words.en: Something that is ancestral relates to ancestors or to something that has been passed down from ancestors.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: n. （房屋、土地等的）租用期限；租赁；
words.ex: The tenancy lasts for one year.
words.ex_cn: 租期为一年。
words.en: The period of time for which a property is rented.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 鬼似的；幽灵般的；可怕的
words.ex: The ghostly figure walked silently through the night.
words.ex_cn: 那个幽灵般的身影在夜里安静地走着。
words.en: Resembling or characteristic of a ghost; eerie or spectral.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.ex: His smile seemed insincere.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑显得不真心。
words.en: If you say that someone is insincere, you are being critical of them because they say things they do not really mean, usually pleasant, admiring, or encouraging things.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.tr: v. 使合乎标准；使合规格
words.ex: The school will standardize the test scores next month.
words.ex_cn: 学校下个月将统一评分标准。
words.en: To standardize something means to make it conform to a standard or norm, especially in order to ensure consistency and uniformity.

words.ex: They shared a brotherly bond that transcended their differences.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间有一种超越差异的兄弟情谊。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as brotherly, you mean that it is kind and affectionate, like the way a brother would behave.

words.tr: adj. 道歉的；谢罪的；愧疚的
words.ex: He gave an apologetic smile after bumping into her.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到她后露出了歉意的微笑。
words.en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for having caused someone trouble or unhappiness.

words.ex: The courageous firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从着火的房子里救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is courageous shows courage.

words.ex: The restaurant serves a famous delicacy called seafood soup.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅供应一道著名的佳肴，叫海鲜汤。
words.en: Delicacy refers to the quality of being delicate, fine, or subtle in appearance, structure, or manner. It can also denote a choice or rare food item.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: The provincial government opened a new school.
words.ex_cn: 省政府开设了一所新学校。
words.en: Relating to a province or provinces; having the manners, viewpoints, etc., considered characteristic of unsophisticated inhabitants of a province; narrow-minded.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He gave an acknowledgment of his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认了自己的错误。
words.en: An acknowledgment is a statement or action which recognizes that something exists or is true, or which shows that you are grateful for something.

words.ex: I acquaint him with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 我让他熟悉新规则。
words.en: If you acquaint someone with something, you tell them about it so that they know it.

words.ex: He is an activist who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助穷人的积极分子。
words.en: An activist is a person who works to bring about political or social change by campaigning, public speaking, or demonstrating.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.tr: v. 击败；敲打；“beat”的现在分词； n. 打；打败；
words.ex: Our team was beating the rivals in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的队伍在决赛中击败了对手。
words.en: The act of hitting someone or something repeatedly, or a defeat in a game or competition.

words.tr: v. 将遇到麻烦；灾祸降临
words.ex: Whatever betide, we must remain strong.
words.ex_cn: 无论发生什么，我们都必须保持坚强。
words.en: If something betides you, it happens to you.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.ex: He paddles a canoe on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着独木舟在湖上航行。
words.en: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.

words.tr: adv. 粗心大意地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He drove carelessly and hit a tree.
words.ex_cn: 他粗心地开车，撞上了一棵树。
words.en: Without taking care or paying attention to what you are doing.

words.ex: He could not conceive a world without technology.
words.ex_cn: 他无法设想一个没有科技的世界。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; to become pregnant.

words.ex: He plays a violin concerto at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏一首小提琴协奏曲。
words.en: A concerto is a musical composition usually composed in three parts or movements, in which one solo instrument is accompanied by an orchestra.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.tr: v. 投入；献身；“devote”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 全心全意的；投入的；
words.ex: He devoted all his time to helping his students.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有时间都投入到了帮助学生上。
words.en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: The teacher asked a simple question to elicit answers from students.
words.ex_cn: 老师问了一个简单的问题来引出学生的回答。
words.en: To elicit a response or a reaction means to cause it to happen by something that you say or do.

words.ex: The Industrial Revolution was a new epoch in history.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命是历史上一个新时代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: They erect a flagpole in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立一根旗杆。
words.en: If people erect something such as a building, bridge, or barrier, they build it or create it.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.ex: He fondled the old photo gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻抚摸着那张旧照片。
words.en: To handle or touch (someone or something) in a tender and loving way.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.tr:
n. 教养；养育；培育；
v. 培养；
words.ex: Her parents gave her good nurture.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母给了她良好的教养。
words.en: To nurture someone or something is to care for and encourage their growth or development.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.tr:
n. 机会主义者
adj. 机会主义的；投机的；见风转舵的
words.ex: He was criticized as an opportunist who would do anything for personal gain.
words.ex_cn: 他因投机取巧、为个人利益不择手段而受到批评。
words.en: An opportunist is someone who takes advantage of any opportunity to achieve an end, often with little regard for principles or consequences.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: He outranks his boss in the military.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中的军衔比他的老板高。
words.en: If one person outranks another, they have a higher position or rank than the other person.

words.ex: The sky is overcast today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空多云。
words.en: If the sky or the day is overcast, it is covered with cloud; dull and not sunny.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: The bus was overcrowd with passengers.
words.ex_cn: 这辆公交车挤满了乘客。
words.en: To fill a space with more people or things than is comfortable or safe.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: He bought a packet of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一小包糖。
words.en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

words.tr:
n. 挂锁；扣锁
v. 用挂锁锁上
words.ex: He secured the gate with a padlock.
words.ex_cn: 他用挂锁锁住了大门。
words.en: A padlock is a lock which is used for fastening two things together, for example two parts of a door or a lid on a container. It consists of a block of metal with a U-shaped bar attached to it. One end of the bar is released by turning a key in the lock.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: The stormy sea crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨的海浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: Characterized by strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.

words.tr: v. 跨坐；骑；分腿站立；横跨
words.ex: The boy straddled the fence to see the game.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跨坐在围栏上观看比赛。
words.en: To sit or stand with one leg on each side of something; to extend over or across something; to take a non-committal position on an issue.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: The treacherous road made driving very scary.
words.ex_cn: 这条危险的道路让驾驶非常可怕。
words.en: If you describe someone as treacherous, you mean that they are likely to betray you and cannot be trusted. If you say that something is treacherous, you mean that it is very dangerous and unpredictable.

words.tr: adj. 未成形的；不成熟的
words.ex: The clay is still unformed.
words.ex_cn: 这块黏土还没有成形。
words.en: If you describe something as unformed, you mean that it is not yet fully developed or it does not yet have a definite shape.

words.tr: adj. 不稳的；动摇不定的；不规则的
words.ex: He walked in an unsteady way after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 他喝酒后走路不稳。
words.en: If you describe something as unsteady, you mean that it is not firm or stable, and seems likely to change, move, or collapse.

words.ex: He drove unwisely in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他在雨中愚蠢地开车。
words.en: In a way that is not sensible or prudent.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.ex: The weather is changeable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: If something is changeable, it can be changed or it changes often.

words.tr: adj. 技艺高超的；完成的；熟练的； v. 完成；实现；“accomplish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an accomplished pianist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位技艺高超的钢琴家。
words.en: If someone is accomplished at something, they are very skilled at it.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: The cartoon is satirical and makes fun of politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这幅漫画是讽刺性的，嘲笑政客。
words.en: A satirical piece of writing or speech uses satire to criticize people or ideas.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.ex: He suffered an indignity at the hands of the guards.
words.ex_cn: 他受到了守卫的羞辱。
words.en: An indignity is a situation or event that causes you to feel ashamed or embarrassed because it involves something that is unfair or insulting.

words.ex: The prison conditions were inhumane.
words.ex_cn: 监狱的条件是不人道的。
words.en: If you describe something as inhumane, you mean that it is extremely cruel.

words.tr: adj. 纵容的；宽厚的；溺爱的
words.ex: Her parents are indulgent and let her stay up late.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母很纵容，让她熬夜。
words.en: If you are indulgent, you treat someone with special kindness, often in a way that is not good for them.

words.ex: He tried to gild the old box with gold paint.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用金漆把旧盒子镀金。
words.en: To cover something with a thin layer of gold or to make something seem more attractive or valuable than it really is.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.tr: adj. 充满快乐的；使人高兴的
words.ex: The children were joyous on Christmas morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节早上非常快乐。
words.en: If you describe something as joyous, you mean that it is full of joy and happiness.

words.ex: The glass is brittle and breaks easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃很硬但容易碎。
words.en: If something is brittle, it is hard and easily broken.

words.ex: He bought a stainless steel knife.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一把不锈钢刀。
words.en: Stainless is used to describe something that does not rust or stain easily, especially stainless steel.

words.tr: adj. 完备的；设施独立的；独立自足的；沉默寡言的
words.ex: The cabin is self-contained with its own water and electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小屋是自给自足的，有自己独立的水和电。
words.en: A self-contained place or thing is complete and does not need other things to function or exist.

words.tr: adj. 自己经营的；个体经营的；非受雇于人的
words.ex: He is self-employed and works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是自由职业者，在家工作。
words.en: Someone who is self-employed works for themselves rather than for an employer.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He faced an accusation of stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他面临偷钱的指控。
words.en: An accusation is a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal.

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.ex: The advertiser showed a new TV commercial.
words.ex_cn: 广告商播放了一则新的电视广告。
words.en: An advertiser is a person or company that pays for a product, service, or event to be advertised.

words.ex: The bison walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 野牛慢慢地走过草原。
words.en: A bison is a large, wild animal that is related to the cow and is native to North America and Europe. Bison have a large head, a humped back, and are covered with thick, shaggy hair.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.tr: v. 探索；游览；“explore”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are exploring the forest to find new plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在探索森林以寻找新的植物。
words.en: To travel through or examine an area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.tr: v. 保持；保留；“keep”的现在分词； n. 一致；保管；
words.ex: She is keeping the room clean.
words.ex_cn: 她正在保持房间干净。
words.en: The act of holding onto something or maintaining it in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.tr: n. 过路人；考试合格者；传球手
words.ex: A passer saw the accident and called the police.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人看到了事故并拨打了报警电话。
words.en: A passer is someone who is walking past a place, especially when something unusual is happening there.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: He picked up a small pebble from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了一颗小石子。
words.en: A pebble is a small, smooth, round stone, especially one found on a beach or in a river.

words.ex: The rabbit ate a small pellet of food.
words.ex_cn: 兔子吃了一颗小球状的食物。
words.en: A pellet is a small, rounded, compressed mass of a substance.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: The flowers will perish if you don't water them.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们会死。
words.en: If people or animals perish, they die as a result of very harsh conditions or as the result of an accident.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: The playful puppy chased its tail.
words.ex_cn: 那只爱玩耍的小狗追着自己的尾巴跑。
words.en: Someone who is playful is full of fun and likes to play.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.tr: adj. 复数的； n. 复数；
words.ex: The word 'cats' is a plural form.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cats' 是复数形式。
words.en: The plural form of a word is the form that is used when referring to more than one person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The porter carried his bags to the taxi.
words.ex_cn: 行李搬运工把他的行李搬到了出租车上。
words.en: A porter is a person whose job is to carry things, especially travelers' luggage at places such as railway stations or hotels.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr:
n. 邮戳
v. 盖邮戳于
words.ex: The letter has a postmark from 1995.
words.ex_cn: 这封信上有1995年的邮戳。
words.en: A postmark is a mark stamped on a letter or package by the postal service, indicating the date and place of mailing.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.ex: You can take the bus, preferably early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 你可以坐公交车，最好是在早上早些时候。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferably to another, you mean that the first thing is more desirable or suitable than the second.

words.ex: The seahorse swims slowly in the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 海马在珊瑚礁中缓慢游动。
words.en: A seahorse is a small marine fish with a head and neck that look like those of a horse.

words.tr:
adj. 刺耳的；尖声的；尖厉的
v. 尖叫；发出刺耳的声音
words.ex: The baby's cry was shrill.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的哭声很尖锐。
words.en: A shrill sound is high and unpleasant to listen to.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr: v. 鼓励；“spur”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher's praise spurred him to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 老师的表扬鼓励了他更加努力学习。
words.en: If something spurs you to do something, it encourages you to do it.

words.ex: His upbringing taught him to be honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的抚育让他学会了诚实和善良。
words.en: The way that a child is cared for and taught how to behave while it is growing up.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.ex: The utilization of solar energy is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的利用正在增加。
words.en: Utilization is the act of using something effectively.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.tr:
n. 雨夹雪
v. 下雨夹雪；下冰雹
words.ex: The road was slippery after a night of sleet.
words.ex_cn: 经过一夜的冻雨，路面变得很滑。
words.en: Sleet is a form of precipitation consisting of ice pellets, often mixed with rain or snow.

words.ex: He repents for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为对母亲撒谎而悔恨。
words.en: If you repent, you feel or express sincere regret or remorse about something wrong you have done.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: He got a nomination for best actor.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳男演员的提名。
words.en: The act of officially suggesting someone or something for a position, prize, or honor.

words.ex: The fog reduced the visibility on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 雾降低了高速公路上的可见性。
words.en: The condition of being able to see or be seen; the degree to which something can be seen, especially in weather conditions.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.tr: v. （使）变直；（使）变平；（使）变整齐；
words.ex: He straightened the crooked picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上歪斜的画扶直了。
words.en: To make something straight or to put something in order.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.tr:
n. 发酵；酵素；动乱
v. （使）发酵；动乱
words.ex: The ferment of yeast makes bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 酵母的发酵使面包膨胀。
words.en: If a substance ferments or if it is fermented, it changes chemically because of the action of yeast or bacteria, often producing alcohol.

words.ex: He quickly jot down the phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙记下了电话号码。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: The children played in the grit near the road.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在路边的沙砾中玩耍。
words.en: Grit is very small pieces of stone. It is often used to make surfaces less slippery. Grit is also a quality of character that enables someone to continue with determination in the face of difficulties.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: This phone is the flagship model of the company.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机是该公司的旗舰型号。
words.en: The most important product, service, or project of a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 先见；预见；先见之明
words.ex: He showed foresight by saving money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他通过为未来存钱展现了远见。
words.en: The ability to predict or the action of predicting what will happen or be needed in the future.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.tr: adj. 建筑学的；建筑方面的；
words.ex: The book shows architectural drawings of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了古老建筑的建筑图纸。
words.en: Relating to the art and science of designing and constructing buildings.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.tr: v. 设计；“design”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 精心设计的；
words.ex: The house was designed for easy living.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是为方便生活而设计的。
words.en: If something is designed for a particular purpose, it is intended for that purpose.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: He majored in forestry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修森林学。
words.en: The science or practice of planting, managing, and caring for forests.

words.tr: n. 女管家；主妇；房屋管理人
words.ex: The housekeeper cleans the rooms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 管家每天早上打扫房间。
words.en: A housekeeper is a person whose job is to manage the cleaning, cooking, and other household tasks in a private home or institution.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the moorland.
words.ex_cn: 羊在荒原上吃草。
words.en: Moorland refers to an area of open uncultivated land, especially in Britain, that is characterized by wet, peaty soil and dominated by grasses, heather, and moss.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；主要的；基本的；最好的；
words.ex: This is the prime reason for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 这是延误的首要原因。
words.en: Prime is used to describe something that is of the best possible quality, or the most important or basic part of something.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He has great proficiency in English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: If you show proficiency in something, you show ability or skill at it.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: They decided to prolong the meeting by one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议延长一小时。
words.en: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.tr: n. 所有者；经营者 ；业主
words.ex: The proprietor runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 店主经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: A proprietor is a person who owns a particular type of business, especially a hotel, a shop, or a company.

words.ex: The city became prosperous after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市变得繁荣了。
words.en: A prosperous person, place, or economy is rich and successful.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He punched the wall in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地打了墙一拳。
words.en: To punch means to hit someone or something hard with your fist, or to make a hole in something using a tool.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
n. 询问；疑问；问号
v. 询问；怀疑
words.ex: He made a query about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了公交车的时刻表。
words.en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask in order to check that something is true or correct.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: He radically changed his mind about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底改变了对这个计划的想法。
words.en: In a way that is very different from the usual or traditional way.

words.ex: The radioactive material glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这种放射性物质在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

words.ex: Radium glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 镭在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Radium is a chemical element with the symbol Ra and atomic number 88. It is the sixth element in group 2 of the periodic table, also known as the alkaline earth metals. Pure radium is silvery-white, but it readily reacts with nitrogen (rather than oxygen) upon exposure to air, forming a black surface layer of radium nitride.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: v. 使恢复精力；使复原；使变新
words.ex: A short nap can refresh you.
words.ex_cn: 小睡一会儿能让你恢复精力。
words.en: To refresh someone means to make them feel less tired or less hot.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: adj. 后悔的；失望的；令人惋惜的
words.ex: He looked regretful after shouting at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在对朋友大喊后看起来很后悔。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret; sorrowful or sorry

words.ex: It is regrettable that he missed the train.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了火车，这令人遗憾。
